events.title: Teradyne at IEEE International Test Conference
events.why: Only upcoming event on Teradyne's IR page; semiconductor test demand commentary two weeks before Q3 results.

events.title: BYD Paris Motor Show press conference, unnamed world premiere
events.why: New model plus France/Europe plans; Dolphin G DM-i is its first Europe-designed car.

events.time: 12:10 ET Mon (03:10 AEDT Tue Oct 13), per a calendar snapshot; not on the Board calendar
events.title: Cleveland Fed President Hammack, luncheon speech, NABE annual meeting
events.why: Hammack dissented for a hike in July; the minutes show regional presidents wanting 1-2 more hikes, so this is the hawkish read before CPI.

events.time: Oct 12-15, San Jose; US bond market shut Oct 12 (Columbus Day), equities open
events.title: OCP Global Summit 2026 (open compute racks, networking, power)
events.why: Data-centre hardware roadmaps for NVDA, MRVL, ALAB, AVGO, GEV; rack-power and optics news tends to leak by the Tuesday.

events.title: IMF and World Bank Annual Meetings, Bangkok
events.why: Global growth and AI-capex outlook from the IMF, plus possible US-Japan talk on yen weakness; finance ministers and central bankers on the sidelines.

events.time: All day (US); equities open, no Fed or BLS releases
events.title: Columbus Day: US federal holiday, bond market shut by convention
events.why: Thin liquidity and no US data; the Fed and BLS both note any release scheduled for the day moves to Oct 13, so the week's data starts Tuesday.

events.title: Paris Motor Show: Tesla Cybercab first European display, BYD stand
events.why: First Cybercab showing in Europe; EU FSD decision expected December.

events.title: BYD Da Han flagship EV launch
events.why: Pre-sale 249,900-299,900 yuan, 1,008 km CLTC; deliveries within two weeks. Final price is the read.

events.time: 9:00 a.m. ET Tue Oct 13 (00:00 AEDT Wed Oct 14); press-only 'Apple Experience' in Tribeca, New York; livestream not confirmed
events.title: Apple 'Welcome home' launch: HomePad, Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2 (expected)
events.why: Apple confirmed the date and 9:00 a.m. ET invitation on Oct 8. Format is a press event, not a keynote; Apple has not said whether it will stream or simply post press releases and video. Products are unconfirmed by Apple; reports point to a HomePad smart display, new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini 2.

events.title: Fed Governor Waller discussion on AI, Bloomberg New Economy Forum, New Delhi
events.why: Waller said Oct 8 he expects more hikes and named AI-driven high-tech consumer prices as an inflation pressure; an AI-focused session is where he could tie the capex boom to the rate path.

events.time: JPM 07:00 ET (22:00 AEDT), call 08:30 ET; WFC 07:00 ET, call 10:00 ET; Citi ~08:00 ET, call 11:00 ET; Goldman 07:30 ET (22:30 AEDT), call 09:30 ET (00:30 AEDT Wed); BAC and MS Wed Oct 14 pre-open
events.title: Q3 bank earnings start: JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Citi, Goldman (BAC, MS Oct 14)
events.why: Goldman's Oct 13 date and 07:30 ET release confirmed by the firm's own schedule; opens Q3 season with a read on deal flow and consumer credit at a 5.24% 10-year.

events.title: US existing-home sales, September (NAR)
events.why: First resale print with the 30-year mortgage at 7.40%; matters for RKT, LDI and AXOS.

events.time: Oct 13-15, Moscone Center, San Francisco (last autumn edition; moves to Phoenix in spring 2027)
events.title: SEMICON West 2026
events.why: Chip-equipment and packaging demand commentary in the same week as ASML and TSMC results.

events.title: RBA minutes of the Sep 28-29 meeting (hiked to 4.60%, 9-0)
events.why: Shows how seriously the Board weighed a hold; the tell for whether Nov 3 is a fifth hike or a pause.

events.title: Anthropic pre-IPO investor day
events.why: Management Q&A on growth, compute costs; public S-1 would need to follow by about Oct 23 for a Nov 9 roadshow.

events.time: About 07:00 CEST Wed (16:00 AEDT Wed; 01:00 ET)
events.title: ASML Q3 2026 results and Q4 guide (Q3 guide EUR 11.0-12.0B sales, 55-57% gross margin)
events.why: Guide was EUR 11.0-12.0B sales, 55-57% margin; 2027 outlook is the read for chip equipment.

events.title: Fed Beige Book
events.why: Anecdotal read on hiring and pricing two weeks before the FOMC; matters only if it contradicts the CPI print that morning.

events.time: 05:40 ET (20:40 AEDT Wed) IIF panel; 22:55 ET (13:55 AEDT Thu) speech, topic TBA
events.title: Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman, two Bangkok appearances
events.why: Supervision-focused, but Bowman is a voter and the second speech has no announced topic, so an economic-outlook comment is possible hours after US CPI.

events.title: US September CPI (PPI follows Thu Oct 15, 08:30 ET)
events.why: Last inflation print before the Oct 27-28 FOMC; a hot core number is the main risk to long-duration growth holdings.

events.time: 09:30 CST Wed (12:30 AEDT Wed; 21:30 ET Tue)
events.title: China September CPI (NBS)
events.why: Domestic demand pulse for BABA, BYD and the China internet names; NBS dates are preliminary.

events.title: Cleveland Fed's Hammack speaks (second appearance of the week)
events.why: After CPI, PPI and retail sales are all out; a hawkish read from a regional president would firm up the 18% October hike odds before the blackout.

events.title: Fed Chair Warsh fireside chat with IMF's Georgieva, Bangkok
events.why: Last scheduled Warsh appearance before the FOMC blackout; the only chance to hear the Chair on the October decision after the CPI print.

events.title: US September PPI (day after CPI)
events.why: Feeds the PCE nowcast ahead of the Oct 27-28 FOMC; a hot goods-PPI is the tariff pass-through check for the industrial names.

events.time: 08:30 ET (23:30 AEDT Thu), same slot as PPI
events.title: US September advance retail sales (Census)
events.why: Consumer pulse into Prime Big Deal Days and the holiday quarter for AMZN, HOOD and the mortgage names; lands alongside PPI and TSMC's results.

events.title: Australia labour force, September (ABS)
events.why: Confirmed on the ABS release calendar. Last jobs print before September CPI on Oct 28 and the RBA's November meeting.

events.title: US initial jobless claims, week to Oct 10 (prior 197K)
events.why: Waller's case for more hikes rests on a stable labour market; claims under 200K keep that case intact and keep the 10-year near 5.25%.

events.title: Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Business Outlook Survey, October
events.why: First October read on US factory orders, capex plans and prices paid, relevant for machinery names and for whether tariff and energy costs are still feeding goods inflation.

events.title: NY Fed Empire State Manufacturing Index, October
events.why: Lands alongside PPI, retail sales, claims and Philly Fed in one 08:30 ET print, the heaviest US data minute of the fortnight.

events.title: Tesla Roadster demo, SpaceX McGregor TX (moved from Oct 1, weather)
events.why: Watchlist; sentiment event only, production still guided to 2027-28. Second slip in a month.

events.time: 14:00 Taipei (17:00 AEDT Thu; 02:00 ET); quiet period Oct 5-14
events.title: TSMC Q3 2026 results, Q4 guide and 2026 capex update (Q3 guide $44.6-45.8B, GM 65-67%)
events.why: Holding; the single best read on AI demand for NVDA, AVGO, MRVL and ALAB, and it lands in the owner's evening. Consensus ~$45.8B, top of the range.

events.time: Import/export prices 08:30 ET (23:30 AEDT Fri); industrial production 09:15 ET (00:15 AEDT Sat)
events.title: US September import/export price indexes (BLS) and industrial production (Fed G.17)
events.why: Last tariff-pass-through and factory-output reads before the Oct 27-28 FOMC; IP is the machinery-capex pulse for GEV, TER and the industrial names.

events.time: US close 16:00 ET (07:00 AEDT Sat Oct 17)
events.title: Monthly US equity options expiry (third Friday)
events.why: Can add volatility to a week already loaded with CPI, banks and TSMC.

events.time: TBC (standing rule: second Saturday before the meeting through Oct 29)
events.title: FOMC communications blackout begins ahead of Oct 27-28 meeting
events.why: No Fed speakers from Oct 17 until the Oct 28 decision, so the hike-vs-hold debate moves to the data (housing starts, claims, flash PMI) and Treasury auctions.

events.time: 10:00 CST Mon (13:00 AEDT Mon; 22:00 ET Sun)
events.title: China Q3 GDP (NBS)
events.why: Growth read for BABA, BYD and China-exposed semis; NBS has delayed releases before, so treat the date as preliminary.

events.title: Texas TCEQ compliance report due under Abbott's data-center permit freeze
events.why: A reporting deadline, not an end to the pause; shows how broadly the freeze reaches (including island-mode generation) for GEV, VRT and Texas AI campuses.

events.time: 10:00 Beijing (13:00 AEDT Mon; 22:00 ET Sun Oct 18); house prices 09:30 Beijing
events.title: China September industrial production, retail sales, fixed-asset investment and 70-city house prices (with Q3 GDP)
events.why: The activity data behind the Q3 GDP print; retail sales test whether the Golden Week and the Hong Kong rebound have consumer spending behind them for the China internet names.

events.title: US housing starts and building permits, September
events.why: First starts print with the 30-year mortgage above 7.4%; a sharp drop would hit construction-machinery demand and the mortgage lenders on the watchlist.

events.time: 13:01 PT Tue (16:01 ET; 07:01 AEDT Wed Oct 21); video interview 13:45 PT (07:45 AEDT Wed)
events.title: Netflix Q3 2026 results (company outlook: revenue $12.86B, operating income $4.27B, EPS $0.82)
events.why: Holding; first read on the co-CEO era's ad tier and content spend, and a consumer-internet check before AMZN, GOOGL and META at month end.

events.title: Nvidia GTC Berlin (Washington D.C. edition is Nov 30-Dec 3, keynote Dec 1)
events.why: Holding; European sovereign-AI and Rubin deployment announcements. Dates from Nvidia's session catalog; Nvidia's own event page for Berlin was not opened.

events.title: IBM Q3 2026 results and webcast
events.why: Enterprise AI software and consulting demand read-through for the internet and AI names; IBM reports before the hyperscalers.

events.title: Lam Research September-quarter (fiscal Q1 2027) results and call
events.why: Wafer-fab equipment orders are the cleanest signal of whether AI memory and foundry capex is still rising after the OpenAI revenue scare; direct read for Micron, TSMC and Nvidia exposure.

events.title: US Treasury 20-year bond auction
events.why: With the 10-year at 5.24% and Pimco talking about 6%, a weak long-bond auction is the kind of event that re-rates growth multiples; no 10- or 30-year auctions fall in the window.

events.time: After US close; Q&A webcast 5:30pm ET = 8:30am AEDT Thu Oct 22
events.title: Tesla Q3 2026 results and Q&A webcast
events.why: Confirmed in Tesla's 8-K. Auto margins, energy storage and Cybercab ramp commentary.

events.title: Vertiv Q3 2026 results (date unconfirmed; Oct 21 or Oct 28)
events.why: Guided Q3 revenue $3.65-3.85B, EPS $1.77-1.83; consensus EPS $1.57. Company has not announced the date; Q2 date was announced two weeks ahead.

events.title: US initial jobless claims, week to Oct 17
events.why: Last claims print before the Oct 28 FOMC decision, inside the blackout.

events.title: Conference Board Leading Economic Index, September (August -0.1% to 99.5)
events.why: Low-impact recession gauge; date from the Conference Board's August release.

events.time: Before US open Thu; Q&A call 8:00 a.m. ET (23:00 AEDT Thu)
events.title: Spotify Q3 2026 results
events.why: Confirmed by Spotify's Business Wire release of Sept 24, 2026: results Thursday Oct 22 before market open, management Q&A at 8:00 a.m. ET via webcast at investors.spotify.com, questions through Slido code #SpotifyEarningsQ326. Spotify IR pages did not render via fetch, so the release was read via Finviz's carry of the wire.

events.title: S&P Global US flash manufacturing, services and composite PMIs, October
events.why: Prices-paid and new-orders components will set the tone into the FOMC; a hot print raises the October hike odds from 18%.

events.title: University of Michigan consumer sentiment, October final (prelim 46.3; 1-yr inflation 4.7%, 5-yr 3.5%)
events.why: Inflation expectations rose for a second month to the highest since May; Waller explicitly flagged de-anchoring risk, so an upward revision feeds straight into the Fed path.

events.title: Brazil presidential runoff: Flavio Bolsonaro vs Lula
events.why: Bolsonaro led 47.1-45.1 in the first round; Brazilian assets and MELI rallied. A Lula win would reverse much of that.

events.title: Bloom Energy Q3 2026 results (estimated, not announced)
events.why: MarketBeat estimate based on last year's schedule; Bloom has not posted a notice. Consensus EPS $0.14 (one estimate). FY26 revenue guide $3.9-4.2B.

events.time: After US close; call 16:30 ET (07:30 AEDT Wed Oct 28)
events.title: Enphase Q3 2026 results (guide revenue $290-320M, GAAP GM 42-45%)
events.why: Holding; confirmed by Enphase's Oct 6 release. Guide implies GAAP margin well below Q2's 60%.

events.time: After US close; call 17:00 ET (08:00 AEDT Wed)
events.title: Robinhood Q3 2026 results and video call
events.why: Confirmed by the company Oct 1. First quarter with prediction-market and Agents disclosures; watch transaction revenue and net deposits.

events.title: Teradyne Q3 2026 results
events.why: Q3 guide was $1.2-1.3B; stock is down 10% into the print after a 182% one-year run.

events.time: 14:00 ET statement, 14:30 ET press conference (05:00 / 05:30 AEDT Thu Oct 29)
events.title: FOMC decision (meeting Oct 27-28), futures 81.6% hold / 18.4% hike
events.why: Outside the fortnight but the event everything in it feeds into; the Fed hiked in September and Waller wants more.

events.title: GE Vernova Q3 2026 results and webcast
events.why: Confirmed on the IR events page (7:30-8:30am EDT). Q2 EPS missed; watch gas orders, wind losses and FY guide after JPMorgan's target cut.

events.time: Call 13:30 PT / 16:30 ET (07:30 AEDT Thu Oct 29)
events.title: Alphabet Q3 2026 results and call
events.why: Holding; confirmed on Alphabet IR. Cloud growth and capex guide are the AI read; lands hours after the FOMC decision.

events.title: Australia CPI, September (ABS)
events.why: On the ABS release calendar; key input for the RBA after the September hike to 4.60%.

events.time: TBC (after US close per third-party calendars; ~07:30 AEDT Thu Oct 29)
events.title: Meta Q3 and Microsoft fiscal Q1 2027 results (dates not yet confirmed by either company)
events.why: Holding (META); Wall Street Horizon infers Oct 28 for both; Amazon inferred Oct 29, Apple Nov 2, none confirmed.

events.time: TBC (likely morning KST = Tue Oct 27 evening ET)
events.title: SK hynix Q3 2026 results (date unconfirmed)
events.why: TipRanks lists Oct 27 after US close, Quartr Oct 28; company has not posted. Consensus EPS $6.13 vs $1.25 a year ago. Samsung's prelim miss sets a nervous backdrop.

events.title: Keyence fiscal Q2 results
events.why: StockAnalysis lists Oct 29 (previous refresh had Oct 28-29). Order trends in China and US automation.

events.time: After 16:00 ET; call 17:00 ET (08:00 AEDT Fri Oct 30)
events.title: Axos Financial fiscal Q1 2027 results and call
events.why: Holding; company release confirms Oct 29 (one calendar wrongly shows Oct 30).

events.time: Governing Council Oct 28-29, press conference Oct 29 (evening AEDT Thu)
events.title: ECB monetary policy decision and press conference
events.why: Just outside the window; the only other G3 decision before the BoJ on Oct 30 and BoE on Nov 5, relevant for European exposure such as SAP and ASML.

events.title: Intel Q3 2026 earnings call
events.why: Outside the window; foundry and PC-CPU demand read for the semis, lands the day after the FOMC.

events.title: Cloudflare Q3 2026 results
events.why: Stock is at a 52-week high above the mean target; the print has to beat and raise.

events.time: After US close; call 16:30 ET (08:30 AEDT Wed Nov 4)
events.title: Astera Labs Q3 2026 results
events.why: Guided EPS $1.16-1.21; consensus revenue ~$551M. Date reported Oct 7 (company IR page could not be opened).

events.title: MercadoLibre Q3 2026 results (provisional)
events.why: IR calendar lists Nov 4 as provisional, replacing the earlier ~Oct 28 assumption. Watch credit-book growth and operating margin after Q2's 6.7%.

events.title: Sea Limited Q3 2026 results
events.why: Shopee margin and SeaMoney credit quality after a Q2 EPS miss.
